items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: He was a big advocate of St. Joseph and St. Teresa.

ctx.x: Let me ask you for some of the things that he was talking about and saying.

Well, he spoke of his past. We had in the past year, though, spoke much about his past, his life. He had mentioned... He pleaded with me not to take him to the hospital. He felt it would be his last trip in. And I told him I wouldn't never take him under his consent, other than he would be out. Like, I had taken him in September, even when he had a heart attack. He was unconscious for hours, is when I had taken him into the hospital, where he didn't remember going into the hospital. But this time he went in…
What was the afternoon before he died?
